title: A C^1 scalar function is bounded and uniformly alpha-Hoelder on a compact convex subset of its open domain
statement: Let n be a natural number, alpha a real number with 0 < alpha <= 1, U an open subset of R^n, K a compact convex subset of U, and f : R^n -> R a function that is C^1 on U. Then there is a real S >= 0 such that |f(x)| <= S and |f(x) - f(y)| <= S |x - y|^alpha for all x, y in K.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → K ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → ∃ S : ℝ, 0 ≤ S ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, |f x| ≤ S ∧ |f x - f y| ≤ S * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
